mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_template (goal_type, goal_keyword, total_days, difficulty, plan_outline, daily_tasks_template, ai_model, usage_count, success_count, quality_score, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{goalType}, #{goalKeyword}, #{totalDays}, #{difficulty}, #{planOutline}, #{dailyTasksTemplate}, #{aiModel}, #{usageCount}, #{successCount}, #{qualityScore}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE plan_template SET usage_count = usage_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE plan_template SET success_count = success_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE plan_template SET quality_score = #{score}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
